preregistered.question: on the ACTIVE frame -- the 14,913 tiles above a pure threshold on the label at 0.5778 -- does the published conv encoder (widths 6/20/75, 13,217 params) beat a single GC number by MORE than the +0.0122 it manages on the pooled frame?
preregistered.frame: active-only; leave-peak-out applied WITHIN the active subset, so train and test are both active and the comparison matches the 2026-11-16 scratch design whose +0.1820 margin calibrated the thresholds below
preregistered.protocol: dna_decode.glm.encoder.REGISTERED_PROTOCOL, unchanged -- architecture-matched to the published +0.0122 rather than retuned for this frame

pooled_reconcile_anchor.why_pooled: the anchor exists only on the pooled frame; asserting it there BEFORE changing frames is the only way to prove the data and split are right

preregistered.why_not_blind: the 2026-11-16 scratch measurement (4-mer ridge, +0.1820 active-frame margin on 10 of 10 seeds) motivated these thresholds, so they were set with a directional expectation in view. Recorded in the same field name wiki/asgiven_arm_result_2026-11-02.json uses.
preregistered.why_frozen_after: this project's standing rule: a bar frozen BEFORE the analysis that says what a correct fix can achieve is mis-specified, and the two bars mis-specified that way this quarter were both frozen too early. The mechanism here -- GC is a detector, a learned representation is not -- was analysed first and the thresholds set against it.
preregistered.does_not_extend: scripts/glm_encoder_gate.py::PREREGISTERED is NOT edited. Its reconcile anchor is broken by the active frame by construction, so sharing it would rewrite a commitment and force INDETERMINATE_RECONCILE_FAILED.

verdicts.FRAME_EXPLAINS_THE_GAP: active-frame margin >= +0.15 on at least 8 of 10 seeds -- the pooled +0.0122 was a frame artifact to first order
verdicts.FRAME_CONTRIBUTES: margin > +0.05 with a paired CI excluding zero -- the frame carries part of the gap but not the whole of it
verdicts.FRAME_DOES_NOT_EXPLAIN: margin <= +0.05, or the CI includes zero -- the frame hypothesis is tested and rejected
verdicts.INDETERMINATE_NULL_NOT_CLEAN: the shuffled-label arm itself scores on this frame, so the pipeline fabricates signal and NOTHING is graded
verdicts.INDETERMINATE_POOLED_RECONCILE_FAILED: gc seed 0 did not reproduce 0.3000 on the POOLED frame, so this script is not reading the published data and nothing is interpretable

framing_recommendation.FRAME_EXPLAINS_THE_GAP: DECLARE TWO CRITERIA -- detection and strength -- and score future bacterial arms on both. A single pooled number would keep averaging two tasks whose answers differ in sign.
framing_recommendation.FRAME_CONTRIBUTES: KEEP the pooled frame as primary and ADD the active-frame margin as a required disclosure beside it. Not enough separation to justify re-basing every future number.
framing_recommendation.FRAME_DOES_NOT_EXPLAIN: KEEP THE POOLED FRAME AND DECLARE NOTHING. This is the load-bearing entry: re-framing onto a subset with no measured headroom would score every future arm on a frame strictly worse than today's.
framing_recommendation.INDETERMINATE_NULL_NOT_CLEAN: NO FRAMING CHANGE. An ungraded run cannot inform a scope decision.
framing_recommendation.INDETERMINATE_POOLED_RECONCILE_FAILED: NO FRAMING CHANGE. Fix the read path first.
